critic.note: Scores are from the first critic pass. Applied its changes in one fix pass: own crew photo in the hero, brighter PBR membrane and stronger sun, callouts moved off the model on dark tags, shorter scroll stage, job file on a membrane-white ground with one dominant photo, white sections alternating with blue. Typography score was judged on the sandbox fallback font (Google Fonts blocked in QA); live page loads Zilla Slab. Not re-scored (pass limit).

brand_truth: The roof over the brands you know: a Bahamian family contractor, factory-certified on Carlisle, Elevate, Englert, Sika, Siplast and Tremco systems, serving The Bahamas since 2002.

design.signature: A procedural 3D Bahamian commercial block whose roof lifts apart layer by layer on scroll, each layer named with a drawn leader line; a finish picker re-skins the same roof.

current_site_findings: Two websites are live; thermosetbahamas.com still says South Florida contractor.
Homepage opens with 'Welcome to the pinnacle' and a shopping cart icon.
Client list buried under resort photos that are not Thermoset's own.
WhatsApp promised but no number shown; TikTok link misspelled.
Tax ID printed in the public footer.
pitch_line: Your clients are Baha Mar, Atlantis and the airport, so your site should show the roof itself: here it comes apart layer by layer, in your own words, with your crew's photos.
assumptions: Layer descriptions for deck, vapour retarder, insulation boards and cover board are generic category descriptions, not Thermoset's own text.
Estimate work order is routed to the GM's email (croix.culmer@).
Client list taken from Thermoset's portfolio page; confirm every name may be shown publicly.
notes: Generation 2 rebuild from scratch. Direction A06/P14/T07/N4/M4. 12 own job photos (several untitled, captioned neutrally), 1 Commons aerial, 9 Lovable illustrative photos (2 rounds: removed a cruise ship and hotel towers from backgrounds; mod-bit.jpg still has a small distant cruise ship). Ask owner for a WhatsApp number and high-res project photos per system to replace the generated ones. Record location (Paradise Beach Rd) is outdated; site uses 7 Portago Road, Oakesfield.
